## Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

dir.create(here("data", "dfm"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("output", "dfm_figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Read the NSO division indices (2023 base)

```{r}
raw <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "nso_cpi_groups_2026-09-28.xlsx"), sheet = 1, skip = 1)

cpi_long <- raw |>
  rename(base = 1, group = 2) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(base, group), names_to = "month", values_to = "index") |>
  mutate(index = as.numeric(index), date = ym(month)) |>
  filter(!is.na(index))

div <- cpi_long |>
  filter(str_sub(base, 1, 4) == "2023", !str_detect(group, "^Ерөнхий")) |>
  select(date, group, index)
```

## Short English codes for the 13 divisions

```{r}
codes <- c("Хүнс" = "food",           "Согт" = "alcohol_tobacco",
           "Хувц" = "clothing",       "Орон" = "housing_utilities",
           "Гэр " = "furnishings",    "Эм т" = "health",
           "Тээв" = "transport",      "Холб" = "communication",
           "Амра" = "recreation",     "Боло" = "education",
           "Зочи" = "restaurants_hotels", "Даат" = "insurance_finance",
           "Буса" = "other")

div <- div |> mutate(code = unname(codes[str_sub(group, 1, 4)]))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(div$code)))

div |> group_by(code) |> summarise(start = min(date), end = max(date), months = n())

saveRDS(div, here("data", "dfm", "division_indices_2023base.rds"))
```

## Keep the 12 divisions with full history

```{r}
div12 <- div |> filter(code != "insurance_finance")
```

## Seasonally adjust each division and compute monthly inflation

```{r}
sa_one <- function(idx, code) {
  tryCatch(
    as.numeric(seasonal::final(seasonal::seas(ts(idx, start = c(2010, 1), frequency = 12)))),
    error = function(e) { message("X-13 failed for ", code, ", using unadjusted"); idx }
  )
}

div_sa <- div12 |>
  arrange(code, date) |>
  group_by(code) |>
  mutate(index_sa = sa_one(index, first(code)),
         pi_sa    = 1200 * log(index_sa / lag(index_sa))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(pi_sa))

div_sa |>
  group_by(code) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(pi_sa), sd = sd(pi_sa), months = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(sd))

saveRDS(div_sa, here("data", "dfm", "division_inflation_sa.rds"))
```

## Look at all 12 series

```{r}
p_div <- ggplot(div_sa, aes(date, pi_sa)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ code, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Annualized monthly inflation, SA (%)")
p_div
ggsave(here("output", "dfm_figures", "division_inflation_sa.png"),
       p_div, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

## Drop education and communication (administered, once-a-year price changes)

```{r}
div11 <- div_sa |> filter(!code %in% c("education", "communication"))
```

## Outlier adjustment (Stock-Watson rule) and standardization

```{r}
sw_clean <- function(x, k = 6) {
  out <- abs(x - median(x)) > k * IQR(x)
  for (t in which(out)) {
    x[t] <- if (t > 1) median(x[max(1, t - 5):(t - 1)]) else median(x)
  }
  x
}

div_clean <- div11 |>
  group_by(code) |>
  mutate(pi_clean = sw_clean(pi_sa),
         outlier  = pi_clean != pi_sa,
         z        = (pi_clean - mean(pi_clean)) / sd(pi_clean)) |>
  ungroup()

div_clean |>
  group_by(code) |>
  summarise(outliers = sum(outlier)) |>
  arrange(desc(outliers))

X <- div_clean |>
  select(date, code, z) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = code, values_from = z) |>
  arrange(date)

dim(X)

saveRDS(div_clean, here("data", "dfm", "division_inflation_clean.rds"))
saveRDS(X,         here("data", "dfm", "panel_standardized.rds"))
```
